description: dibs: share capacity, protect exclusive resources and isolate performance measurements

hooks.command: case "$OSTYPE" in msys*|cygwin*) for b in "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/bin/windows-x64/dibs.exe" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/target/release/dibs.exe"; do [ -f "$b" ] && exec "$b" session-start; done; exit 0;; *) exec "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/bin/dibs" session-start;; esac

case "$OSTYPE" in msys*|cygwin*) for b in "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/bin/windows-x64/dibs.exe" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/target/release/dibs.exe"; do [ -f "$b" ] && exec "$b" hook; done; exit 0;; *) exec "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/bin/dibs" hook;; esac
